services.name: "Sweet" Tiki Boat Cruise Private Charter
services.desc: About You and your friends/family will love this memorable fun and laid back boat cruise around the waterways of Naples on a floating Tiki Bar Boat captained by a US Coast Guard licensed Captain. We are available for private charters up to 6 people. Cruises will go through Naples Bay, Port Royal and into the Gulf of Mexico. Beach cruises available as well. Daytime Cruises are 3 hours and will go to the beach at Keewaydin Island to swim, relax or shell. We've got noodles and a floating raft for you to play on.
